steamNotice: Steam games start through the Steam client, which picks the Proton version and ignores Platypus's env vars. To apply these settings, paste this into Steam → Properties → Launch options:

runner.nativeNote: This game ships a native Linux build from the store. It runs directly, without Proton — runner, DX layer and Proton flags don't apply.
runner.description: The Proton or Wine build that runs this Windows game.
runner.savedMissing: Saved runner is not installed. Pick another or the launch falls back to an error.
runner.noneInstalled: No Proton or Wine runners detected.

sync.label: Sync
sync.description: How Wine coordinates the game's threads. Leave the default unless a fix says otherwise.

titles.fsync: Proton default (fsync when the kernel supports it)

protonFlags.description: Switches Proton reads at launch. Turn one on only when a game or a fix asks for it.

descs.PROTON_ENABLE_NVAPI: Expose NVAPI to the game (DLSS, Reflex on NVIDIA)
descs.PROTON_HIDE_NVIDIA_GPU: Report NVIDIA GPUs as AMD to work around vendor checks
descs.PROTON_NO_D3D11: Disable D3D11 so the game falls back to another API
descs.PROTON_NO_D3D12: Disable D3D12 so the game falls back to D3D11
descs.PROTON_FORCE_LARGE_ADDRESS_AWARE: Let 32-bit games use more than 2 GB of RAM
descs.PROTON_OLD_GL_STRING: Shorten the GL extension string for old games

graphics.dxDescription: DXVK translates DirectX 9–11 to Vulkan and is the usual choice. WineD3D uses OpenGL; try it only when a game fails with DXVK.

dxTitles.dxvk: The DXVK build shipped with the selected runner

graphics.shaderDescription: DXVK saves shader state between runs, so later launches stutter less. Off sets DXVK_STATE_CACHE=0.

launch.pipelineDescription: Each switch wraps the launch command in one more program.
launch.gamescopeHint: Run the game inside a gamescope session
launch.workdirHint: Where the game runs. Empty means the executable's folder.
launch.prefixCustom: This prefix, for this game only. Empty falls back to the default prefix folder.
launch.prefixDefault: Empty: this game uses a folder of its own in the default prefix folder. The folder is created on demand.
launch.badKey: Letters, digits and _ only; cannot start with a digit

gsToggleTitles.hdr: --hdr-enabled: enable HDR output (needs the Gamescope WSI layer)

year.saveError: Platypus couldn't save the release year.

tweaks.title: Suggested tweaks
tweaks.intro: Based on this machine, not the game's rating: a platinum game can still need them on your GPU.
tweaks.steamNote: Steam applies these only through the game's <lo>launch options</lo>.

maintenance.busy: {{title}} is busy; its files can't be changed until this finishes.
maintenance.removeRunning: Stop {{title}} before removing it from the library.
maintenance.removeBackupFirst: Saves will be backed up first.
maintenance.removeNoSaves: No known saves for this game.
maintenance.removeError: Platypus couldn't check what removing {{title}} would delete.
maintenance.verifyText: Checks {{title}}'s files against {{plugin}}. A check only reports; repairing asks first.
maintenance.moveText: Moves the game's folder to another folder or disk. Platypus checks the room first and keeps the old copy until the new one is checked.
maintenance.uninstallText: Removes the game's files from this computer. Your saves in the cloud stay where they are.
maintenance.uninstallConfirmFull: Delete {{title}} — {{size}} in {{dir}}? Your cloud saves stay in the cloud.
maintenance.uninstallConfirmSize: Delete {{title}} — {{size}}? Your cloud saves stay in the cloud.
maintenance.uninstallConfirmDir: Delete {{title}} in {{dir}}? Your cloud saves stay in the cloud.
maintenance.uninstallConfirmBare: Delete {{title}}? Your cloud saves stay in the cloud.
